name: Further Mysteries
summary: In the Alterac foothills, a decrypted letter leaves Prospector Stormpike searching for meaning. He sends you to Southshore's magistrate with the message.

sections.title: A Letter Without Meaning
sections.body: Prospector Stormpike has decrypted the letter you found among thieves in the Alterac foothills. Yet its meaning escapes him, and he wonders why thieves had it at all. Southshore lies nearest to Alterac. If a threat is brewing, its magistrate should hear of it, so you carry the message to Magistrate Henry Maleb.

sections.title: What Maleb Reads
sections.body: Magistrate Henry Maleb studies the letter and judges that no thief or Alterac noble could have written it. Its words point to a darker power behind the Syndicate. Maleb shudders at the thought of what that power might be.

faq.q: Who sends you with the decrypted letter?
faq.answer: Prospector Stormpike decrypted the letter but cannot make sense of it. He sends you to Southshore's magistrate because the town lies nearest to Alterac.

faq.q: Who needs to see the decrypted letter?
aliases: where do i take the letter
faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore needs to see the decrypted letter. Stormpike says Southshore lies nearest to Alterac, so its magistrate should hear of any brewing threat.

faq.q: Where did the original encrypted letter come from?
faq.answer: You found the original encrypted letter among thieves in the Alterac foothills before taking it to Prospector Stormpike.
